explication: Feishin is a self-hosted music client for Jellyfin, Navidrome, and Subsonic servers, packaged as a desktop app and also offered as a web client. The typical workflow is to connect to a music server, browse its library, and play music through a selected player backend; lyrics, playlists, and a phone-friendly remote are additional capabilities. The graph combines README-documented product flows with source-index relationships and shown IPC/API calls. Some feature wiring is unsampled, so uncertain links are omitted or dashed.
